follow-up time: Duration of pregnancy and postpartum period
exposure: Esophageal varices induced by portal vein thrombosis
cohort: 7 pregnant women with portal hypertension and esophageal varices induced by portal vein thrombosis admitted between 2000 and 2012
finding: Pregnant women with portal hypertension and esophageal varices can deliver at term, but it is a high-risk pregnancy that may necessitate cesarean delivery under general anesthesia with remifentanil to minimize complications.
mod_finding: All women delivered at term (37-40 weeks) and underwent cesarean delivery under general anesthesia with remifentanil.
